svg.title: How I build: standards a script enforces. Guard checks for tokens, copy, errors, types, env, secrets, length, tests and migrations.
svg.text: Standards a script enforces, not a style guide.
Raw colours, ad-hoc type and untyped any are blocked
on the line they are written.
AI features ship with eval sets in CI. Latency claims
Tests, types, lint and guards gate every merge.
no raw colours or ad-hoc type
every string goes through copy keys
named errors, never a generic one
